exercises.instruction: Напишите предложения. Используйте информацию из рамок + and/but/or.
wordBank: Do you want me to come with you?
I went by bus this morning.
I swam to the other side.

answers: I stayed at home and watched TV.
I bought a sandwich, but I didn’t eat it.
I went to the window and looked out.
I went to the window and I looked out.
I wanted to phone you, but I didn’t have your number.
I jumped into the river and swam to the other side.
I jumped into the river and I swam to the other side.
I usually drive to work, but I went by bus this morning.
Do you want me to come with you, or shall I wait here?

exercises.instruction: Посмотрите на картинки и закончьте предложения. Используйте and/but/so/because.

answers: so he opened the window.
because it was raining.
because the weather was bad.
but it was closed.
so he didn’t eat anything.
so he didn’t want anything to eat.
because there was a lot of traffic.
because the traffic was bad.
goodbye, got into her car and drove off.
goodbye, got into her car and drove away.

exercises.instruction: Напишите предложения о том, что вы делали вчера. Используйте and/but и т. д.

modelAnswers: In the evening I stayed at home and studied.
I went to bed very early because I was tired.
I went to the cinema, but the film wasn’t very good.
I went to a café and met some friends of mine.
There was a film on television, so I watched it.
I got up in the middle of the night because I couldn’t sleep.

exercises.instruction: Переведите предложения на английский язык. (устроить пикник = have a picnic; пропустить = miss; выглядеть = look; сыро = wet)

answers: Yesterday we went to the park and had a picnic there.
